title: WU-E Uniform-Community Temporal Convergence
purpose: Measure time-step sensitivity of the intended fixed-FTP WU-E heat accumulation and urban propagation law on a fixed grid, using low- and high-HRR families.
source_checkout_note: The mapped files were byte-identical to the named revision. The inspected checkout also contained pre-existing changes in other files and is not represented as globally clean.
source_files: elmfire_spread_rate.f90: UMD_UCB_BLDG_SPREAD lines 547-565 and WU-E heat accumulation
elmfire_level_set.f90: WU-E heat update and CFL/RK2 integration
building_dimension_semantics: linear characteristic building dimension in metres

regimes.label: low-HRR temporal-convergence family
regimes.sampled_field_expectation: positive finite received heat at every resolution; no energy-branch change is part of the intended law

regimes.label: high-HRR propagating temporal-convergence family
regimes.sampled_field_expectation: positive finite received heat and complete propagation observables at every timestep
